modules.name: core
modules.desc: Runtime: module registry, shared scroll/viewport observers, reduced-motion handling

modules.name: reveal
modules.desc: Scroll-triggered entrances: data-motion="fade-up" (30 presets), data-motion-children, data-motion-stagger

modules.name: text
modules.desc: Typography: data-text="reveal|fade|blur|chars|wave|scroll|highlight" (+ add-ons below)

modules.name: text-scramble
modules.desc: data-text="scramble": decoding/hacker text (data-text-trigger="hover" for links)

modules.name: text-typewriter
modules.desc: data-text="typewriter" (+ data-words="a|b|c" to cycle)

modules.name: text-rotate
modules.desc: data-text="rotate" data-words="a|b|c": sliding word carousel

modules.name: text-fx
modules.desc: data-text="glitch|neon|explode|roll|proximity|flip": flashy + interactive text

modules.name: text-particles
modules.desc: data-text="particles": headline made of particles that scatter from the cursor

modules.name: circle-text
modules.desc: data-circle-text="Scroll * down * ": rotating circular text badge

modules.name: counter
modules.desc: Count-up numbers: data-count-to="2500" data-count-suffix="+"; data-count-style="odometer" rolls digits

modules.name: parallax
modules.desc: Depth: data-parallax="0.3" (scroll), data-mouse-parallax="25" (pointer)

modules.name: scroll
modules.desc: Scroll-linked: progress bar, data-scrub="scale-in|fade-in|slide-left|rotate|spin|zoom-out|tilt-3d|blur-in|clip|text-fill"

modules.name: story
modules.desc: Pinned storytelling: data-horizontal (sideways gallery), data-steps + data-step (scrollytelling)

modules.name: scrollfx
modules.desc: data-stack (stacking cards), data-expand (media grows full-screen), data-velocity (scroll skew), data-page-color

modules.name: magnetic
modules.desc: data-magnetic="0.35": element pulled toward the cursor

modules.name: tilt
modules.desc: data-tilt="12": 3D tilt toward the cursor (+ data-tilt-glare)

modules.name: spotlight
modules.desc: data-spotlight / data-spotlight="group": cursor glow + glowing border on cards

modules.name: ripple
modules.desc: data-ripple: click ripple

modules.name: holo
modules.desc: data-holo (holographic foil card), data-flashlight (cursor spotlight reveal)

modules.name: cursor
modules.desc: Custom cursor on <body data-cursor="ring|dot|blend|blob">, labels via data-cursor-text

modules.name: trail
modules.desc: data-cursor-trail="glow|sparkle|comet": cursor trails

modules.name: image-trail
modules.desc: data-image-trail="a.jpg|b.jpg" (images follow the cursor), data-hover-image (list preview)

modules.name: widgets
modules.desc: data-carousel (3D ring), data-dock (magnify), data-drag (throw / spring)

modules.name: marquee
modules.desc: Infinite marquee: data-marquee, -speed, -direction=left|right|up|down, -pause, -scroll

modules.name: draw
modules.desc: SVG line drawing: <svg data-draw> or data-draw="scroll"

modules.name: loader
modules.desc: Intro loader: data-loader="fade|curtain|split|circle|columns" with [data-loader-count]

modules.name: transition
modules.desc: Page transitions: <body data-transition="fade|curtain|slide|columns|view">

modules.name: confetti
modules.desc: Confetti + spark bursts: data-confetti, data-confetti="view", data-burst, MotionKit.confetti() / burst()

modules.name: effects-ambient
modules.desc: CSS loops: mk-float mk-float-slow mk-spin-slow mk-pulse mk-glow mk-blob mk-ping mk-bounce mk-scroll-hint

modules.name: effects-text
modules.desc: CSS text fills: mk-gradient-text mk-shine

modules.name: effects-surface
modules.desc: CSS surfaces: mk-gradient-border mk-border-beam mk-shimmer mk-glass

modules.name: effects-hover
modules.desc: CSS hovers: mk-hover-lift mk-hover-grow mk-link mk-btn-fill mk-btn-shine mk-hover-wiggle

modules.name: effects-interactive
modules.desc: CSS interactions: mk-flip-card (3D flip on hover), mk-accordion (expanding panels)

modules.name: bg
modules.desc: Background layer engine for data-bg (each type below is its own module)

modules.name: bg-gl
modules.desc: WebGL shader engine used by liquid, blobs, orb, beams, tunnel (MotionKit.shaderBg)

modules.name: bg-particles
modules.desc: data-bg="particles": linked dots network, cursor-reactive

modules.name: bg-stars
modules.desc: data-bg="stars": warp starfield (dark sections)

modules.name: bg-waves
modules.desc: data-bg="waves": flowing layered waves

modules.name: bg-matrix
modules.desc: data-bg="matrix": code rain

modules.name: bg-grid
modules.desc: data-bg="grid": synthwave perspective grid

modules.name: bg-dots
modules.desc: data-bg="dots": interactive dot matrix

modules.name: bg-bokeh
modules.desc: data-bg="bokeh": soft glowing orbs

modules.name: bg-snow
modules.desc: data-bg="snow": falling (or data-bg-rise) particles

modules.name: bg-aurora
modules.desc: data-bg="aurora": drifting color blobs (CSS, cheapest)

modules.name: bg-gradient
modules.desc: data-bg="gradient": rotating blurred mesh gradient

modules.name: bg-noise
modules.desc: data-bg="noise": animated film grain

modules.name: bg-liquid
modules.desc: data-bg="liquid": WebGL flowing liquid gradient (--mk-liquid-opacity, default .6)

modules.name: bg-fluid
modules.desc: data-bg="fluid": interactive WebGL fluid simulation - the cursor swirls glowing ink ("splash cursor")

modules.name: bg-blobs
modules.desc: data-bg="blobs": WebGL lava-lamp metaballs; the cursor adds a blob

modules.name: bg-orb
modules.desc: data-bg="orb": glowing swirling AI orb that reacts to hover

modules.name: bg-beams
modules.desc: data-bg="beams": volumetric light rays from above, following the cursor

modules.name: bg-tunnel
modules.desc: data-bg="tunnel": neon wormhole flying toward the viewer

modules.name: bg-globe
modules.desc: data-bg="globe": rotating 3D dotted Earth with glowing arcs (data-bg-drag to spin)

modules.name: bg-galaxy
modules.desc: data-bg="galaxy": 3D spiral galaxy of glowing stars

modules.name: bg-warp
modules.desc: data-bg="warp": grid that bends around the cursor like gravity

modules.name: bg-flow
modules.desc: data-bg="flow": generative flow-field particle trails; the cursor stirs a vortex
